# Contributing

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CONTRIBUTING.vi.md)

Open an issue before large changes. Keep the original-model/no-quantization contract intact unless the scope is explicitly changed. Run `make audit` before submitting a pull request. Do not commit model weights, secrets, Kaggle tokens, Hugging Face tokens, generated caches, or private evidence.
